title: Arcade Gears Vol. 1: Pu·Li·Ru·La
native_title: ＡＧアーケード・ギアーズ プリルラ
overview:
The adventurous journey of Zak and Mel in the mysterious land of Radishland. A complete port of a legendary lost masterpiece of arcade action games!

Let's play together, the two of you, as friends!!

In Radishland, time keeps flowing thanks to the Keepers who turn a key deep beneath each village. When a villain steals a time key and stops time, Zak and Mel take up magic wands and set out to get it back.

This beat-'em-up is filled with cute characters and surreal, bizarre enemies. Bop foes with combo wand strikes, jump attacks and back swings, then watch them turn into animals you can grab for bonus points. Cast screen-clearing spells whose effect depends on your score, or join forces with a second player for a special team spell. Each round ends with a battle against a possessed Keeper.

- 1-2 players, cooperative
- Comes with a strategy guide written by Gamest staff

不思議な国ラディッシュランドで起こるザックとメルの冒険の旅。
アーケードアクションゲームの幻の名作を完全移植！

ふたりで仲良くLet's Play！！
